title: Require nonempty mapping for SCHC MappingSent CDA selection
description: Correctness codereview found Cda::MappingSent descriptors can be selected with mapping=None or an empty mapping whenever the MO is not MatchMapping. Compression/decompression then fails after selection instead of allowing rule fallback. Require a present nonempty mapping whenever MO=MatchMapping or CDA=MappingSent, retain width validation for every entry, and test all MOs with None, empty, singleton, multi-entry, and out-of-width mappings.
